description: This file defines the NatsAdapterFactory class, which implements the IQueueAdapterFactory interface for creating and managing NATS-based stream adapters within the Orleans framework. It includes methods for initializing the factory, creating adapters, retrieving cache and queue mappers, and handling delivery failures.

classes.name: NatsAdapterFactory
classes.description: A factory class responsible for creating and managing NATS stream adapters in Orleans, including configuration, initialization, and failure handling.

methods.name: NatsAdapterFactory
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the factory with configuration options and dependencies.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes the factory, setting a default failure handler if none is provided.

methods.name: CreateAdapter
methods.description: Asynchronously creates and returns a new NATS stream adapter.

methods.name: GetQueueAdapterCache
methods.description: Returns the cache used for stream adapters.

methods.name: GetStreamQueueMapper
methods.description: Returns the stream queue mapper used for distributing streams.

methods.name: GetDeliveryFailureHandler
methods.description: Returns a failure handler for a specific queue.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Static method to create an instance of NatsAdapterFactory using dependency injection and configuration.
